mapper.select: SELECT Q.QNA_IDX AS qnaIdx, Q.USER_IDX AS userIdx, Q.QNA_TYPE AS qnaType, Q.TITLE AS title, Q.QUESTION AS question, Q.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, CASE WHEN A.QNA_A_IDX IS NULL THEN '답변대기' ELSE '답변완료' END AS answerStatus FROM QNA Q LEFT JOIN QNA_A A ON Q.QNA_IDX = A.QNA_IDX WHERE Q.USER_IDX = #{user_idx} ORDER BY Q.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT QNA_IDX AS qnaIdx, USER_IDX AS userIdx, QNA_TYPE AS qnaType, TITLE AS title, QUESTION AS question, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM QNA WHERE QNA_IDX = #{qna_idx} AND USER_IDX = #{user_idx}
SELECT QNA_A_IDX AS qna_a_idx, QNA_IDX AS qna_idx, TITLE AS title, ANSWER AS answer, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM QNA_A WHERE QNA_IDX = #{qna_idx}
mapper.insert: insert into qna values( seq_qna.nextval, #{user_idx}, #{qna_type}, #{title}, #{question}, sysdate )
